method: Read all 309 'name' fields from /Users/shravan/Desktop/appetite-probe/insurtech-dataset.json, lowercased, and diffed against every company name recovered across all new sources this pass (InsurTech NY events/competition/2026 sponsors/2023 map, InsurTech America-Hartford Innovation Challenge, Global Insurance Accelerator, gener8tor/OnRamp, Plug and Play). Did not edit the dataset file itself, per instructions.

headline_numbers.caveat: The 182 'not in dataset' figure is NOT the same as '182 insurance-core misses'. A large fraction are: (a) already-excluded categories per the project's existing exclusion logic (HR/PEO like Justworks/Namely, health-tech/benefits like Nayya/Healthee/Youth Health Tech, pure fintech/wealth like Rocket Dollar/Sora Finance), (b) conference sponsors that are law firms, payroll/BPO vendors, or non-insurance tech vendors (Troutman is a law firm; Truist is a bank; Clark Hill is a law firm), (c) very early-stage/low-signal competition entrants with almost no public footprint beyond one pitch-deck mention, or (d) companies whose product category is ambiguous from the source alone (e.g. 'Boost', 'Leo', 'Vaartani' - single-word names with no further description recovered).
